summary: Game Arts' Sega Genesis action-platformer, later preserved through the Sega Genesis Mini and Nintendo Classics.

entries.title: Alisia Dragoon

emulation.emulator: Nintendo Switch Online Genesis app or Genesis Plus GX
emulation.notes: Switch Online is the current official access path; use an owned-dump emulator only for archival capture.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Genesis/Mega Drive presentation with emulator save-state and rewind conveniences.

primary.why: The Switch Online Genesis release is the current official route with modern emulator conveniences; the Genesis cartridge and Genesis Mini releases do not add exclusive playable content.
primary.how_to_play: Use the SEGA Genesis app through Nintendo Switch Online + Expansion Pack. For archival capture, use an owned Genesis/Mega Drive copy or dump in a Genesis emulator.

entries.remaster_caveats: Modern availability is through emulation, not a remaster.
